capabilities: Toggle a manual lock per base file via command, status badge or file-explorer menu
Block cell edits, checkbox toggles, paste, cut, edit keys and drags in locked views
Hide view settings, sort, filter and New controls while keeping the view-switch menu
Apply folder and glob lock rules and editable-property exceptions (Pro)
Lock all bases vault-wide in kiosk mode, including files created later (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a file-permission tool; it only guards the Bases interface and notes stay editable in their own editor.
extras: Freemium: manual locks are free; folder/glob rules, editable properties and kiosk mode require a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors payment, with GitHub sign-in checks that cache up to 14 days offline. After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (disable in Settings). README lists untested areas: mobile touch, third-party kanban layouts, custom themes, pop-out windows, screen readers; Bases DOM classes are not a documented API and may break on Obsidian updates.
problem: Bases tables let a stray click, keystroke or drag silently change cell values, cards or view settings while you are only reading or presenting a base.

relations.evidence: The build needs Obsidian 1.13.4 or later and the core Bases plugin.
Sign in uses the GitHub device flow.

summary: Read-only lock for Obsidian Bases views that blocks cell edits, checkbox toggles, typing, paste and drags while keeping file links clickable.
